verses.en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos da província que subiram do cativeiro, dentre os exilados, a quem Nabucodonozor, rei de Babilônia, tinha levado para Babilônia, e que voltaram para Jerusalém e para Judá, cada um para a sua cidade;
verses.en_web: Now these are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the people of the divisions of the kingdom, among those who had been made prisoners by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and taken away to Babylon, who went back to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his town;

verses.en: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.pt: Estes foram os que subiram de Tel-Mela, de Tel-Harsa, de Querube, de Adã e de Imer; porém não puderam provar que as suas casas paternas e sua linhagem eram de Israel:
verses.en_web: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
verses.en_bbe: And these were the people who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer. But having no knowledge of their fathers' families or offspring, it was not certain that they were Israelites;

verses.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.pt: os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e cinqüenta e dois.
verses.en_web: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

verses.en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.pt: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Hacoz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomou mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e que foi chamado do seu nome.
verses.en_web: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
verses.en_bbe: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who was married to one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and took their name.

verses.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.pt: Estes procuraram o seu registro entre os que estavam arrolados nas genealogias, mas não foi encontrado; pelo que, por imundos, foram excluídos do sacerdócio;
verses.en_web: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
verses.en_bbe: They made search for their record among the lists of families, but their names were nowhere to be seen; so they were looked on as unclean and no longer priests.

verses.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.pt: e o governador lhes intimou que não comessem das coisas santíssimas, até que se levantasse um sacerdote com Urim e Tumim.
verses.en_web: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.en_bbe: And the Tirshatha said that they were not to have the most holy things for their food, till a priest came to give decision by Urim and Thummim.

verses.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.pt: Toda esta congregação junta somava quarenta e dois mil trezentos e sessenta,
verses.en_web: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
verses.en_bbe: The number of all the people together was forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty,

verses.en: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.pt: afora os seus servos, e as suas servas, que foram sete mil trezentos e trinta e sete; também havia duzentos cantores e cantoras.
verses.en_web: besides their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.en_bbe: As well as their men-servants and their women-servants, of whom there were seven thousand, three hundred and thirty-seven: and they had two hundred men and women to make music.

verses.en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.pt: Os seus cavalos eram setecentos e trinta e seis; os seus mulos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco;
verses.en_web: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
verses.en_bbe: They had seven hundred and thirty-six horses, two hundred and forty-five transport beasts,

verses.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.pt: os seus camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; os jumentos, seis mil setecentos e vinte.
verses.en_web: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
verses.en_bbe: Four hundred and thirty-five camels, six thousand, seven hundred and twenty asses.

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
verses.pt: Alguns dos chefes das casas paternas, vindo à casa do Senhor em Jerusalém, deram ofertas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, para a edificarem no seu lugar;
verses.en_web: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.
verses.en_bbe: And some of the heads of families, when they came to the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem, gave freely of their wealth for the building up of the house of God in its place:

verses.en: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests garments.
verses.pt: conforme as suas posses, deram para a tesouraria da obra, em ouro sessenta e um mil dáricos, e em prata cinco mil minas, e cem vestes sacerdotais.
verses.en_web: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
verses.en_bbe: Every one, as he was able, gave for the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand pounds of silver and a hundred priests' robes.

verses.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.pt: Ora, os sacerdotes e os levitas, e alguns do povo, tanto os cantores como os porteiros e os netinins, habitaram nas suas cidades, e todo o Israel nas suas cidades.
verses.en_web: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.en_bbe: So the priests and the Levites and the people and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, took up their places in their towns; even all Israel in their towns.
